SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.366667, -76.933333 (Explicit)
Reported Sheen Size: 40 feet by 200 feet (area 8000 sq. ft.)
Reported Spill Volume: 0.5 gallons
SkyTruth Minimum Estimate: 0.2 gallons
Report Description
EMPLOYEES AT THE CG YARD WERE WORKING ON THE SHIP-LIFT USING A MAN-LIFT AND ONE OF THE HYDRAULIC LINES ON THE MAN-LIFT FAILED, CAUSING HYDRAULIC FLUID TO SPRAY ON THE SHIP-LIFT AND AN UNKNOWN QUANTITY TO ENTER CURTIS CREEK. THIS CREATED A RAINBOW COLORED SHEEN IN CURTIS CREEK THAT MEASURED 40' X 200'. THE MAN-LIFT WAS TAGGED OUT AS MALFUNCTIONING & TOWED TO A LOCATION TO BE REPAIRED. THE SPILLED HYDRAULIC FLUID ON THE SHIP-LIFT WAS CLEANED UP WITH ABSORBENT PADS AND WILL BE DISPOSED OF AS OIL CLEAN UP MATERIALS THROUGH DLA.
